Name: Harvest_Feast_Miller
$Comment: Tomas the Miller's conversation, one of the three villagers standing in the Forgotten Temple while
Harvest Feast runs. Tomas contracts everything: I've, it's, don't.
Start's First beats come first. The off-season beat answers a visit while the feast is off (after a
command ends it, or when a server owner stands Tomas somewhere all year) with one line and goodbye. A
conversation has no Season leaf, so it reads the feature ziggfreedcommon:feature Harvest_Feast_Live,
Quests holds two rows. Supper for Tomas (harvest_feast_supper_tomas), the plate Martha sends him after
The Feast, names only its Ready screen: while the player carries it with the pumpkin pie in the bag,
the conversation opens on supper, his thanks, whose answer hands the pie over. Then his daily, Daily
Flour (harvest_feast_miller_flour): the conversation opens on its offer while it can be taken, on its
brief while it is carried, and on its hand-in once the flour is in the bag. Each hand-in opens his
quest list with Collect in front of the player, and collecting plays this conversation again (each
quest's CompletionDialogue). Otherwise it opens on greeting, the Fallback. Greeting and the flour brief
lead with What needs doing? (Open Quests: the quest list of the character in front of the player, so
his daily and his supper), then his tip on making dough (the dough screen).
The invitation tour's line is not in this file: DialogueExtensions/SeasonsOfOrbis/
Harvest_Feast_Invitation.json adds it to the screens a conversation opens on while the player carries
the tour, after a screen's own lines and before the goodbye group, so goodbye stays last. That line
is spent once a day per conversation, which is why each villager has a conversation of their own.
